_comment: Source videos and verified time ranges for scripts/Extract-WonderVideos.py. Ranges are seconds into the YouTube video; a clip without start/end is the whole video. Every range was verified by OCR of the popup title on sampled frames (2026-09-09). The setting field is generated from the game's placement rules (terrain, features, coast, river, adjacent district) and states what is true around the wonder in every game.

GOBwCB8kXJ4.title: All World Wonders - Civilization 6 (Include DLC)
GOBwCB8kXJ4.notes: 53 world wonder movies in era order with the vanilla completion popup; 1080p60. Chapter times from the description were refined to the exact cut frame.

V3bvZzC73Ns.title: CIV 6 - ALL 34 NATURAL WONDERS SHOWCASE [A TO Z] RISE AND FALL/GATHERING STORM DLC
V3bvZzC73Ns.notes: 34 natural wonder discovery movies in alphabetical order separated by black frames; 1080p60. Carries a small uploader overlay naming the DLC and an IKIGA watermark.
